steps.what: Define research aims, resources, evidence and funder requirements for grants
Write proposal narrative from the funding brief and verified references

loop.purpose: Draft the narrative without inventing findings or commitments
loop.check: Compare scientific claims, budget promises and citations with the supplied sources
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved claims return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Research rationale needs contextual prose; templates only supply headings

steps.what: Finalize submissions and discuss research funding with prospective supporters

tasks.design: Use the {DOCS} funder template and supplied results to draft a proposal with a bounded writing loop. The geneticist checks every claim, finalizes the submission and conducts fundraising conversations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each narrative was assembled from dispersed project material.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can propose wording within the existing document workflow.
tasks.still_hard: Novelty, realistic commitments and funder relationships need scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist decides what research deserves support and can defend its promises.
tasks.altitude: A little drafting time returns to strengthening the research rationale; funding decisions stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a study rationale to research partners
reach.learn: Translate genetic mechanisms into testable clinical questions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound proposal drafting is plausible; the labour estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers proposal preparation and fundraising contact, not grant assessment or executing the study.

The geneticist produces the funding brief in s1: aims, results, source identifiers, budget lines, requested amount, deadlines and commitments. Capture and reference verification remain fully counted; missing material is researched manually, never filled by inference.
Test existing document templates before adding a bounded drafting call; no automatic submission.
Four incremental focal hours per 100 baseline hours cover template and source-policy maintenance.
unknowns: Share of time spent drafting rather than attending events
research_questions: Does a checked draft reduce total writing time without adding unsupported promises?

approvals.approved_version: Exact final proposal text, sources, budget, recipient and commitments; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B100 R89.5 gives 10.5 gross minus 4 upkeep =6.5 net. Event-heavy funding or extensive scientific rewrites reduce the conservative range to 0-3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define genetic research goals and search scientific literature
Compare reported methods, limitations and study conditions across candidate papers

loop.purpose: Extract comparable method details with source passages
loop.input: Selected full papers and comparison questions
loop.output: Method comparison with explicit missing information
loop.check: Read cited passages and verify experimental context, limitations and contradictory evidence
loop.stop: One extraction and correction; ambiguous methods are compared manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Methods and limitations are described in varied scientific prose

steps.what: Select and modify procedures for the genetic research goals

tasks.design: Keep saved searches and paper selection in {DOCS}, then extract a source-linked method comparison with a bounded loop. The geneticist checks the source context and decides how procedures must change for the study.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing differently written methods required repeated manual cross-reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Document extraction can build a provisional comparison for scientific checking.
tasks.still_hard: Transferability to the actual organism, samples and research question is uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist identifies experimental assumptions that a paper does not state clearly.
tasks.altitude: More attention goes to conflicting evidence; method-selection authority stays with the geneticist.

reach.learn: Reproducibility tests and dataset leakage controls

evidence.claim: Elicit supports evidence screening and data extraction; this does not establish valid genetic method selection.
Model knowledge: the checked-comparison saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is literature-based method selection, excluding experimental execution and general professional reading.

In s1 the geneticist captures question, organism, sample type, constraints, comparison fields and selected paper versions. Capture time stays counted; missing full text or ambiguous methods are handled by manual reading or author contact.
Use native reference searches and extraction features first; add custom comparison logic only if those fail.
Three incremental focal hours cover source-access and comparison-field maintenance.
unknowns: Full-text access and permitted processing locations
Time currently spent on comparison tables
research_questions: Does checked extraction preserve exclusions and assay limitations while reducing cross-reading?

already_counted.description: Verify extracted context and correct comparison

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields and source permissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B100 R93.75 gives 6.25 gross minus 3 upkeep =3.25 net. Poorly reported protocols or specialist papers needing full rereading support only 0-1% conservative saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret and approve genetic laboratory results

steps.what: Review genetic laboratory results, resolve uncertainties and record the interpretation or approval

tasks.design: Keep interpretation and approval in the {OTHER} laboratory results system. Use its existing provenance displays while the geneticist examines quality, context and uncertain findings before communicating a result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Uncertain findings do not have a complete rule-based interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing result systems can expose provenance, but the digest does not establish autonomous sign-off.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical significance, inconsistent evidence and implications for relatives require expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist takes responsibility for uncertainty and the significance of a result.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in result-signing authority or time assumptions.

reach.task: Assess evidence supporting a diagnostic hypothesis
reach.learn: Clinical phenotype correlation and assay limitations

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: genetic result interpretation and sign-off remain expert judgements; no labour saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary begins with laboratory results and covers their review, interpretation and release, not sample processing or pipeline execution.

The laboratory analyst produces sample identifiers, assay version, observations, quality metrics and reference versions during separately owned analysis before review. The requesting clinician supplies case context; s1 includes checking completeness, obtaining corrections and entering the interpretation. Missing context pauses release.
The {OTHER} category is a laboratory results system; inspect native provenance and review functions before custom work.
Zero incremental upkeep because this design adds no automation, model or new recurring process.
research_questions: Is any separately measured clerical copying still present without changing interpretation?

already_counted.description: Scientific review, clarification and exact-version approval

approvals.approved_version: Exact sample, assay version, findings, interpretation and recipient; any change requires renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, gross0 upkeep0 net0. Ambiguous clinical variants and routine reviewed results both retain the full expert review; existing machine runtime earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Attend conferences and critically read scientific literature on genetic research advances

tasks.design: Retain scientific reading and conference participation, using existing {DOCS} collections and {CALENDAR} invitations. No reduction in learning time is attributed to summaries or already configured alerts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning depends on evaluating arguments, methods and unresolved questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Search and summary tools exist, but discovery speed does not establish faster understanding.
tasks.still_hard: New findings can contradict established assumptions or lack reproducible support.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist integrates new evidence with experience and asks useful questions of peers.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes; professional learning remains protected work.

reach.task: Critique a paper outside the immediate specialty

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reading and conference attendance are learning activities; automatic summaries do not establish an equivalent learning outcome or time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is general professional learning, excluding literature comparisons for a specific research-method decision.
No machine step requires structured inputs; the geneticist selects papers and sessions during the fully counted learning time.
Use existing reference and calendar configuration before considering custom tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool, feed or mandatory summary process is introduced.
unknowns: Whether alert triage is separately measurable
research_questions: Can any measured discovery overhead be removed without reducing comprehension or attendance?

already_counted.description: Paper selection, critical reading and conference participation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 net0 with no upkeep. Conference-heavy and paper-heavy learning both retain their time until equivalent learning is measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The geneticist gains limited drafting and comparison support while retaining research design, learning and result interpretation.
reach: Help research scientists frame evidence-backed study rationales
Specify reproducible method checks with bioinformatics colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who spends more attention on experimental uncertainty and defensible research choices.
